feeds.title: International Volunteer HQ
feeds.description: International Volunteer HQ provides affordable, safe and responsible volunteer abroad programs. Get inspired with stories, tips and insights from the IVHQ team and our volunteer community.

feeds.title: Global Volunteers - Volunteer Program Blog
feeds.description: Read more about our volunteer service programs though the prospective of our volunteers through our program blogs. Global Volunteers is a private, non-profit, non-sectarian, non-governmental organization engaging short-term volunteers on micro-economic and human development programs in close partnership with local people worldwide.

feeds.title: African Impact - Conservation & Community Volunteering
feeds.description: Volunteer in Africa with the World's Top Rated Volunteer Organization. We believe that volunteering can change lives - help us make a difference to communities and conservation efforts in Africa. Our mission is to offer responsible, safe and meaningful volunteering experiences.

feeds.title: The MovingWorlds Blog - International skills-based volunteering insights and stories
feeds.description: Find the best place to volunteer your expertise, anywhere you want to travel. MovingWorlds believes that Social Enterprises (for- and non-profit) are the most effective drivers of sustainable impact and development. Providing them with strategic knowledge, community, and professional support will accelerate their impact, while at the same time providing rich experiential learning opportunities.

feeds.title: Kaya Responsible Travel
feeds.description: Kaya provides ethical and responsible travel opportunities for participants to volunteer abroad, learn a new language, gain valuable overseas work experience, or take a gap year. Kaya's mission is to promote sustainable social, environmental, and economic development; empower communities around the world; and cultivate educated, compassionate global citizens through responsible travel.

feeds.title: The Salisbury Museum Volunteer Blog
feeds.description: A place to share and discover more about volunteering at The Salisbury Museum.

feeds.title: Mercy Volunteer Corps
feeds.description: Mercy Volunteer Corps is a full-time volunteer program.Volunteers commit to service, a simple lifestyle in community, personal and communal spiritual growth.They serve in education, health care, and social services.Volunteers work especially with people who are economically poor or marginalized, live simply in community, and have the opportunity to commit to personal and communal spiritual growth.

feeds.title: Volunteer /Intern HEEALS
feeds.description: HEEALS is an acronym denoting our commitment to committing human and technical resource to achieve Health Education Environment And Livelihood Society for all. Our vision is to provide resource, knowledge, expertise and leadership to help the people and communities across states of India to use their resources, skills, abilities, and other assets to improve the quality of life, environment, education and livelihood and that of future generation.

feeds.title: Tobi Johnson & Associates - Tobi's Volunteer Management Blog
feeds.description: Helping volunteer organizations strengthen their strategy and mobilize the power of people. Get Tips and Tools for Busy Leaders of Volunteers.

feeds.title: National Student Volunteer Week
feeds.description: National Student Volunteer Week aspires to challenge and celebrate young people who are striving to make change through volunteering. NSVW encourages more meaningful and innovative student engagement. To help students realise not only how much of a difference they can make, but pivoting the way they volunteer, to be more creative and genuine in the way they can help and move others.

feeds.title: Volunteering Solutions | Affordable Volunteer Abroad & Intern Abroad
feeds.description: A handy resource for gap year students, schoolies and travelers who are thinking to volunteer abroad.

feeds.title: Sterling Volunteers Blog
feeds.description: Sterling Volunteers is a volunteer background screening service dedicated to the nonprofit and service sector to help organizations fulfill their service missions and positively impact communities. Learn best practices, insights, and tips to run a quality volunteer program at the Sterling Volunteer blog.

feeds.title: uVolunteer - The Volunteer Life Blog
feeds.description: Read our blog posts for tips, advice, ideas and personal experiences volunteering abroad with uVolunteer in Costa Rica, Ghana & Thailand. uVolunteer is a specialist provider of safe and culturally insightful volunteer work placements overseas. Our goal is to make your dream to volunteer abroad a reality.

feeds.title: Volunteer World
feeds.description: The volunteer abroad blog with latest stories about international volunteering. Ultimate guides, inspiration & trends about international volunteering! Volunteer World's mission is to have lasting positive impact on the volunteer market by providing cost and service transparency of volunteer programs as well as significantly simplifying the search and application process.

feeds.title: ATMA NGO - Volunteer Experience, Education NGO Accelerators
feeds.description: Learn about what Atma volunteers have experienced working with Atma, Mumbai. Atma is an Accelerator for Education NGOs and Social Enterprises in Mumbai and Pune. We empower grassroots education NGOs to become bigger, better and stronger.

feeds.title: Zelos | Volunteer Management App
feeds.description: Zelos Team Management App reduces the stress and confusion for everyone and makes it easy to coordinate, train, and notify your volunteers.

feeds.title: Volunteering India Blog
feeds.description: Read articles about Volunteering, Internships and doing a Gap Year in India.

feeds.title: Timebank
feeds.description: National volunteering charity which runs volunteer mentoring projects to tackle complex social issues. Also works with employers to encourage staff to volunteer.

feeds.title: HandsOn Maui Blog | County of Maui Volunteer Center
feeds.description: We bring good people and good causes together! Find a cause that lights you up in our HandsOn Maui virtual volunteer center powered by GetConnected.

feeds.title: iSpiice - Volunteering in India Blog
feeds.description: Get the updated Tips and Information on Indian Volunteering and Change the life of people with your helping hand.

feeds.title: Volunteer Rutherford
feeds.description: The Volunteer Rutherford website is the most comprehensive resource of charitable organizations in Rutherford County. Their mission is to build a stronger community through encouraging volunteer service and helping connect the citizens of Rutherford County to opportunities in which they can meet critical needs and make a difference.

feeds.title: Friends of Pocahontas State Park - Volunteer Blog
feeds.description: Friends of Pocahontas State Park is a volunteer organization dedicated to supporting Pocahontas State Park in Chesterfield, VA. Thoughts and advice on volunteering at the park.

feeds.title: Conservation Volunteers International Program
feeds.description: Conservation Volunteers International Program is dedicated to helping sustain some of the world's greatest landscapes, cultural sites, and biodiversity. We accomplish our mission by providing opportunities for ordinary people to perform extraordinary volunteer services.

feeds.title: Nurture Africa
feeds.description: Nurture Africa operates projects providing access to Healthcare, Education, Sustainable Livelihoods and Child Welfare for vulnerable families within our areas of operation in Uganda. Nurture Africa believes in working in partnership with community members and supporting them holistically.

feeds.title: Art in Tanzania Blog Volunteer for Africa
feeds.description: Art in Tanzania is a NGO, registered in Finland and Tanzania, receiving around 1,500 volunteers and interns annually. Their mission is to empower youth and promote social awareness in the fields of education, media and art through community developing projects.

feeds.title: African Sunrise Volunteers
feeds.description: African Sunrise, based in the Mother City, places volunteers and Interns from abroad, at various NPO's. We are a small team of women, who strive to bring about change in the Cape Town area, by not only providing volunteers and interns with great, life-changing projects, but by also getting very involved!

feeds.title: Peru Volunteer - Volunteer in Peru and make a difference!
feeds.description: Peru Volunteer wants volunteers to be able to develop themselves, and get to know the beautiful Peruvian culture. At the same time Peru Volunteer wants to help our local partners and have a positive impact on Peruvian society.

feeds.title: Mount Rainier Volunteers
feeds.description: Welcome to the official website of the volunteer and outreach programs of Mount Rainier National Park! Here you'll find all the latest news about our program and the amazing people who work with us to protect Mount Rainier's natural and cultural resources and serve its visitors. Read all about our program, including current volunteer opportunities, upcoming events, and photos of volunteers.

feeds.title: Management4Volunteers Blog
feeds.description: Great volunteer programmes do not fall out of the sky: it is good management practice that makes them even better.

feeds.title: Tata Group | Tata Engage Blog
feeds.description: Tata Engage, the Tata group's volunteering programme, seeks to promote the spirit of volunteering across Tata companies around the world. It strives to encourage the collective giving of time and skills by creating an enabling environment for employees to volunteer, in a living demonstration of the group's ethos of 'Giving back to society.'

feeds.title: Volunteer Work India
feeds.description: Tips on doing volunteer work in India, news, insights and volunteer stories from the field. Go and help in India and make it a better place, Volunteer in India now!

feeds.title: The Real Uganda
feeds.description: Experience the real Uganda with us! Volunteer in Uganda and support projects that foster innovation and motivation. We're the Uganda volunteering experts!

feeds.title: The WildLife Wanderer - Inspiring you to volunteer with animals
feeds.description: An inspiring blog for wanderers wanting to volunteer with animals on their next travel adventure compassionately, ethically and consciously.

feeds.title: VolunteerHub Blog - Thought Leadership and Nonprofit Support
feeds.description: The VolunteerHub blog features insights that make an impact, including the latest on volunteer management and engagement, nonprofit initiatives and more.

feeds.title: Winrock International - Volunteer Posts
feeds.description: Winrock International is a nonprofit organization that works with people in the United States and around the world to empower the disadvantaged, increase economic opportunity, and sustain natural resources.

feeds.title: GVI Blog | Volunteer overseas and travel abroad
feeds.description: Volunteer or intern abroad with GVI and make a sustainable difference while enhancing your personal and professional development! Their mission is to build a global network of people united by their passion to make a difference.

feeds.title: Build Abroad - Volunteer Blog
feeds.description: Here you'll find posts about our trips, news and updates, and helpful travel tips and guides. Build Abroad volunteers build and repair communities all over the world through socially conscious construction services.

feeds.title: Lattitude Global Volunteering
feeds.description: Hear all the latest news from Lattitude and our volunteers working all over the world. Lattitude Global Volunteering is a youth development charity that provides overseas volunteering opportunities for 17-25 year olds. Our mission is to send young people on exciting, rewarding and challenging volunteer placements that support communities in a variety of ways around the world.

feeds.title: Skilled Volunteers for Israel
feeds.description: Skilled Volunteers for Israel links the professional expertise of North American Jews with the critical needs of the Israeli non-profit sector through limited term volunteer engagements.

feeds.title: Involvement, Experience & Volunteering
feeds.description: Changing Lives, Services & Culture. Involvement, Volunteering & Befriending.

feeds.title: Aay's Village Blog
feeds.description: Aay's Village is a non profit project in the jungle of Laos that seeks to improve the education and well-being of the children in the village. We educate 120 children every day in English, IT and Awareness Education, and we do that with the help of our volunteers from all over the world.
